issues.where: Workers · Root Split per-worker column, top-bar NPS chip and search tree, frame at 34 s (18...Bxc4+ think, 4.9/7.0 s)
issues.problem: Five of the eight workers show 0 knps on the deep search, plus 34 and 16 knps on two more. Only W2 is really working (896 knps). The NPS chip drops to 1.6M while BG NPS is 5.6M, and the tree has a single worker path instead of eight. This happens in the hero moment, so the video's main claim ('8 workers / 16 threads') looks broken to anyone reading the numbers.
issues.fix: When one root move dominates (forced checks), split the PV node's subtree recursively, young-brothers-wait style at ply 2–3, so all 8 workers stay on the current think. At the very least, show each worker's background knps in violet in that column (e.g. 'bg 640') instead of a bare 0, and draw idle workers' background lines in the tree.

issues.where: Engine Output · UCI log, every frame, worst at 34 s and 49 s
issues.problem: Most lines are the same filler: 'currmove Bxc4+ currmovenumber 1' or 'currmove Ne2+ currmovenumber 1', 9 of 15 visible lines at 34 s and 11 of 15 at 49 s. With 8 workers searching 39–47 root moves, the move number is never anything but 1. That isn't how UCI reports it, and the log reads as padding, not output.
issues.fix: Emit currmove for the move actually being sent out, with its real root rank, and throttle these lines to about 1 per 500 ms. Fill the rest with real info lines: multipv 2/3 scores, aspiration fail-high/low lines, and hashfull/nps/tbhits updates when the node count crosses a step.

issues.where: Root Moves table vs Iterative Deepening active row, frames at 2 s and 18 s
issues.problem: The iterations row says '43/44 moves resolved' at d10 (2 s) and '50/51 moves resolved' at d13 (18 s). Yet every root-move row still shows the previous depth (all d9, all d12), so the two panels disagree about the same think.
issues.fix: Show each move's own resolved depth in the d column (d10/d13 for moves already resolved this iteration, the old depth dimmed for the rest), or count only the depth the table displays.

issues.where: Root Moves rank 1 vs tree centre and Best-move-by-depth inset, frame at 18 s
issues.problem: Nb1 with an upper bound '≤+1.20' is ranked above Be6 with an exact +1.19. Meanwhile the tree centre, the ply-1 label, the inset and the iteration row all give Be6 +1.20. There are two scores for the best move, and a bound outranks an exact score.
issues.fix: Use one score source for the best move in all panels. When sorting, put an exact score ahead of an upper bound of equal or nearly equal value.

issues.where: Search tree, ply-1 label for Nb1 (lower left of the circle), frame at 18 s
issues.problem: The label shows only '2.2M' with no score line. Every other ply-1 label has a score ('≤-1.40 1.2M'), and this same label had one at 2 s ('≤+0.72 561k').
issues.fix: Fix the label formatter for this bound/state, probably an upper-bound result whose score string comes out empty, so it always prints a score.

issues.where: Root Moves, the PLAYED Δ tag (row 3 at 2 s, row 2 at 18 s, row 1 at 34/49 s)
issues.problem: The PLAYED tag is drawn over the job column and covers the job type (PV/SC/RS) for the one move that matters most. The worker badge next to it is squeezed.
issues.fix: Give the tag its own slot (right after the SAN, or as a row outline plus a narrow Δ column) so the w and job columns stay readable.

issues.problem: EBF drops below 1 (0.83 at d6 in the 18 s frame, 0.91 at d11 in the 49 s frame), next to values of 4.64. An effective branching factor below 1 looks like a bug to anyone who knows engines.
issues.fix: Compute EBF from cumulative nodes per completed depth (N_d / N_{d-1}), or rename the column and explain that it counts per-depth nodes including speculative jobs.

issues.where: Engine Output log vs the UCI options MultiPV setting
issues.problem: MultiPV is set to 3 and the early depths show pv 1/2/3. From about d10 on, only pv 1 appears (pv 2 now and then), because the other root moves come back from scouts with bounds only.
issues.fix: Give the 2nd and 3rd moves exact-window searches each iteration so all 3 lines stay. Otherwise set the MultiPV control to 1.

issues.where: Whole page (frame cost) and the Machine PAGE histogram
issues.problem: The longest frame takes 178 ms of JavaScript, a visible stutter in a 60 fps recording. The frame-time histogram also looks almost empty, with a single bar at 16.7 ms.
issues.fix: Find the long task (probably the tree layout, heatmap redraw or a log flush) and split it across frames or move it to idle time. Use finer histogram bins (e.g. 0.5 ms) so the distribution fills the inset.

critic.summary: This is a strong, believable engine workstation. The walnut-ring search tree is a real hero, and the palette and grid follow the brief closely. The chess checks out: board positions after 16.Bc5, 17.Kf1, 18.Bxb6 and 19.Kg1 are correct, and 17...Be6 is rated !!. The numbers hold together: per-worker nodes add up to the NODES chip (412M and 520M), the wall clock moves at 16 s per frame, the think clocks match 7 s per ply, and hashfull matches between the log and the stats. All panels change over time and nothing looks like a loading state. Two things hurt credibility most. First, at 34 s five workers show 0 knps and the NPS chip drops to 1.6M, which undercuts the 8-worker claim. Second, the UCI log is mostly identical 'currmove … currmovenumber 1' lines. Smaller problems: root-move depths disagree with the iteration table, a bound is ranked above an exact score, one tree label has no score, the PLAYED tag covers the job column, EBF drops below 1, MultiPV 3 lines go missing, and one 178 ms frame hitch. Fix the two major issues and this is postable at 8–9.
